raw_segments.text: The candle, wasted at last, went out. As it expired, I perceived streaks of gray light
edging the window curtains. Dawn was then approaching.
Presently I heard pilot bark far below, out of his distant kennel in the courtyard. Hope
revived. Nor was it unwarranted. In five minutes more the grating key, the yielding
lock warned me my watch was relieved. It could not have lasted more than two hours. Many
